description: This file defines enums, constants, and utility functions related to different AI providers, including mapping, logo retrieval, and model filtering logic.

methods.name: getProviderLogoAndName
methods.description: Returns the logo URL and display name for a given provider value.

methods.name: getPlaceholder
methods.description: Provides a placeholder string depending on the selected provider.

methods.name: getProviderModels
methods.description: Filters and returns models from a model map that match the specified provider.
